items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: But we played mostly for singers. Johnny Mathis was even there.

ctx.x: So you became like the house —
That’s what we were, the house trio. Then we became a quartet. But we played mostly for singers. Johnny Mathis was even there. This was before he was —
